statusDefinitions.Integrated: An extractor/converter ran on the pinned source unit and produced records for every discovered row.
statusDefinitions.Partial: An extractor/converter ran, but output is a subset, legacy-only path, or narrower source class; exclusions or scope gaps are retained.
statusDefinitions.Not Integrated: The domain is in scope but no extractor output is available for this pinned run; unknown metrics are null and needs_run is true.
statusDefinitions.Unsupported: The domain extractor can report absence, but the pinned snapshot does not provide a readable source for the domain.
statusDefinitions.Not Relevant: Reserved for domains outside the Story/Text/Mechanism scope; none of the eight listed domains is Not Relevant.
